question: Should this PR wait for live per-agent Voice Call or Google Meet proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override that proof gate while accepting the scoped Gateway API and upgrade risk?
rationale: The code path appears correct from source and tests, but ClawSweeper's external-PR gate requires real behavior proof for this user-visible routing fix, and the patch expands a trusted plugin Gateway surface.

options.title: Require live routing proof
options.body: Ask for redacted current-head logs, terminal output, or a recording showing two different initiating agents stay separate through Voice Call or Google Meet before merge.

options.title: Override proof with maintainer rationale
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the Testbox-only evidence and record why live carrier or Google Meet proof is not required for this merge.

options.title: Pause until proof is practical
options.body: Keep this PR and the linked bug open until a safe live proof path is available rather than merging a large trust-boundary change on tests alone.

recommendation.title: Require live routing proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted current-head logs, terminal output, or a recording showing two different initiating agents stay separate through Voice Call or Google Meet before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current branch revision and already performed the maintainer pass on the exact affected routing and Gateway surfaces.
